beats.summary: Gabe accuses Andy of causing the printer problems, but Jim and Andy dispute the accusation.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Guys, I think that seems a little unfair. I mean, I feel like we don't definitely know it was Andy.

beats.summary: Michael confides in Jo about his rough year and missing Holly Flax.
Nick reveals he has evidence that Andy is the snitch and confronts the office.

evidence.snippet: Andy: You're going to believe that guy?

beats.summary: Michael publicly issues a full recall of all Sabre GH400 printers and refuses questions.

evidence.snippet: Michael (to press): We at Sabre have betrayed the trust that we have built with our customers.

beats.summary: Jo and Michael share a moment of support and Jo offers to help Michael brighten his life.

evidence.snippet: Jo: I hope your rough patch ends soon.
Jo: Well, give me a shout if I can brighten your life.

Michael (on Jo's jet): Are we going some place far away? I know you said no questions, but… I have an early dinner that I need to get to… with the Chief of Police.
